description: Station upload (GATE G4): goes ONLINE to the PHYSICAL CPU at `ip` and reads its hardware configuration and program into the OPEN project as a new station — it reads the CPU and does not write or stop it (observed on hardware: the CPU stayed in RUN). Back up into a dedicated EMPTY project, never the working project (skill tia-backup). Without confirm it asks serve for an upload plan (PG/PC interface resolved, the open project's path and devices — no network access) and returns a single-use planHash bound to that project; after a human confirms, call again with confirm:true and that planHash. A plan blocked by connection_unresolved because no connectionMode was given asks serve for one more plan per available mode (one at a time, never confirmed; up to 8 modes) and lists the PG/PC interfaces it reports in connectionCandidates (up to 32): repeat without confirm with one candidate's exact connectionMode, pcInterfaceName and pcInterfaceNumber. A read-protected CPU needs its read-access password from a HUMAN (G6 — never invented). Needs the deploy license scope (Basic → 403 scope_required) and app ≥ v1.6.0. Maps to POST /stations/upload/plan and POST /stations/upload. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

confirm.description: G4: true only after explicit HUMAN confirmation

password.description: G6: the CPU read-access password provided by a HUMAN, never invented

planHash.description: G4: the single-use approval token returned by the unconfirmed call (issued only by this MCP process; expires)
